description.value: Casa Del Mila Oro Resort is a family-oriented lakefront resort on Osoyoos Lake, offering fully furnished 3-bedroom townhouses and 2-bedroom condos on 300 feet of private beachfront at the northern tip of the Sonoran Desert. Operating since 2006, it caters to guests drawn to Osoyoos's award-winning wine country, desert hiking, and five nearby golf courses—all popular with Okanagan touring cyclists. Units include full kitchens and private patios, making extended stays practical for self-catering travelers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence comes from the website, which describes a lakefront resort offering fully furnished condos and townhouses; townhouse units explicitly include a 'private garage and patio,' which could qualify as secure bike storage but is never mentioned in the context of cycling. OSM contributes internet_access=wlan but Wi-Fi is not confirmed by the website text, so it remains null per rules. No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage designation, bike wash, e-bike charging, tools, etc.) appear anywhere in the website content, leaving those fields null.
